entries.description: Settles to the sum of every card in play.

entries.name: Sum of evens minus sum of odds
entries.description: Settles to (sum of even cards in play) minus (sum of odd cards in play).
entries.payoffSource: return H.sumWhere(cards, function (c) { return c % 2 === 0; }) - H.sumWhere(cards, function (c) { return c % 2 === 1; });
